title: BiasModded
description: Lightweight vanilla pack that aims to improve existing content.
body:
**A lightweight vanilla+ modpack built around better exploration, immersive sound, and simple quality-of-life improvements that me and my friends made together.**

## 🌍 Improved Exploration
Enhanced terrain and biomes through Terralith and Tectonic More varied and natural world generation without changing the core feel Built to make exploration more rewarding, not overwhelming

## 🔊 Immersion
Proximity voice chat for natural multiplayer interaction Realistic sound physics and improved ambient audio Environments feel deeper without adding complexity

## 🧭 QOL
Minimap and world map for navigation Backpack for extended exploration Small usability improvements like persistent crafting

All mods belong to their respective authors.
